meta.name: hybrid-cloud-networking
meta.description: Configure secure, high-performance connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and cloud platforms using VPN and dedicated connections. Use when building hybrid cloud architectures, connecting data centers to cloud, or implementing secure cross-premises networking.

copy.tagline: 构建本地与云端的安全连接通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在本地数据中心与云平台间建立安全连接
copy.tagline_en: Connect your on-premises data center to cloud securely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish secure connectivity between on-premises and cloud.

howto.what: 该技能让Claude能指导你把自己的机房和云平台（AWS、Azure、GCP、OCI）连起来，用VPN或专用线路建立安全网络连接，并给出配置代码、高可用和监控建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求连接本地数据中心与云平台、构建混合云架构，或实现跨本地与云的安全网络时触发。

say.text: 帮我给本地数据中心和AWS VPC建一条Site-to-Site VPN
say.note: Claude会给出Terraform配置示例和注意事项。

say.text: 我要用Azure ExpressRoute连接本地和Azure，该怎么做？

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude guide you in securely connecting on-premises data centers to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) via VPN or dedicated links, including configuration, HA, and monitoring advice.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to connect an on-premises location to cloud, build hybrid architectures, or implement secure cross-premises networking, such as extending a datacenter to AWS or Azure.

say_en.text: Help me set up a Site-to-Site VPN between my data center and AWS VPC.
say_en.note: Claude provides Terraform configuration and guidance.

say_en.text: I want to connect my on-premises network to Azure using ExpressRoute.
say_en.note: Claude explains ExpressRoute setup and references.

say_en.text: Compare AWS Direct Connect and Site-to-Site VPN for bandwidth and cost.
say_en.note: Claude lists their latency, bandwidth, and pricing traits.
